correctness.rationale: PASS: 24 signed D4 roots ±e_i±e_j have squared norm 2 and exactly four nonzero squared distance shells 2,4,6,8, so normalized class diameters admit only 0,1/2,1/sqrt2,sqrt3/2,1. For the non-obtuse bound (dot>=0), independently enumerated all C(24,6)=134596 six-root subsets and found exactly 24 maximal allowed six-sets, no extendible 7-set; no four disjoint six-sets (the coordinate/diagonal/Hamming argument independently explains why), while five natural sets cover all 24 roots. For the positive-dot threshold, at most three roots form a class and an explicit eight-triangle partition exists. Independently constructed all 96 admissible positive triangles, 64 stars and 32 signed cycles, then complete canonical least-uncovered-mask exact-cover DP gave 12,367 unique states and polynomial 8+2848z^4+4480z^6+320z^8, total 7,656 unlabeled covers. Every k-plateau follows by monotonicity and these sharp thresholds; all claims are finite exactly exhausted, not sampled.
